entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF88602.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color is just... wrong. Looks nothing like the picture.
I understand, that can certainly be disappointing when the color doesn't meet your expectations. I see here that it was delivered to you eight days ago. Is the box unopened?
Yes, the box is unopened. It's just sitting here.
Okay, not a problem at all. You're well within our 90-day return window. Getting the right gear is important for both comfort and safety, so I'm happy to process this return for the helmet for you.

I've just approved the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed.
Whatever. As long as it's handled.
It is. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
